04/19/2024
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes and said the other vehicle drifted into their lane on the driver's
side. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been cooperative in providing the initial account.
04/25/2024
Pohtos taken at the scene confirm several of the details the claimant described, though no independent witnesses
have come forward to speak to how the clolision happened. The police report and a witness statement confirm the
claimant was in the vehicle at the time.
07/15/2024
Inspection of the vehicle shows damage consistent with the described impact along the driver's side. A few older
scratches are visible near the damaged area and may predate this loss; they are being noted separately. Nothing in
the file suggests the damage occurred before the policy coverage began, and the driver is named on the policy.
08/07/2024
Claimant reports a wrist fracture from the impact. The injury fits the kind and force of a collision of this type. Medical
records show a sensible course of treatment that tapered off as the claimant improved.
08/23/2024
Prior records show a minor strain in the same area several years ago, which healed fully with no lasting effects.
Claimant was asked about it and acknowledged it, and the current injury is being evaluated on its own findings.
08/31/2024
Claimant has added a few small details to the account since the first report, but the core description of the lane
change and impact has stayed the same across each interview. The file is being reviewed for settlement based on
the medical and vehicle evidence.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
